title: Vision
heading: A new way to be present.
intro: Our vision for Preacherman is a digital world shaped by presence, individuality and connection. Six pillars guide what we are building.

items.title: Presence
items.text: A digital presence you can see, hear and interact with.

items.title: Identity
items.text: A distinct character with a personality and a sense of self.

items.title: Continuity
items.text: Memories and shared experiences that carry from one encounter to the next.

items.title: Autonomy
items.text: The ability to understand goals and act independently, within the permissions you choose.

items.title: Expression
items.text: Digital identities that give you new ways to express yourself.

items.title: Connection
items.text: A shared gallery where friends can discover the avatars and moments you choose to post.
